items.prompt: Must the expectation of a finite random variable be one of its possible realized values?

options.text: Yes, because an average always appears in the support
options.why: A fair die has mean 3.5 with no 3.5 face.

options.text: No; it is a probability-weighted average
options.why: The average can lie between supported values.

options.text: Yes, unless probability masses sum to1
options.why: Normalization is required regardless of support membership.

options.text: No, because expectation is always undefined
options.why: Finite support and finite values give a defined mean.

items.explanation: Expected value describes the weighted distribution, not a guaranteed or necessarily possible one-trial outcome.
